chunks: A group of our scholars narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Mu'awiya ibn Hukaym, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the one who visits the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) with the intention of Ziyarah. He replied, 'For him is Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the Prophet's grave with the intention of Ziyarah?
ai.summary: In this narration from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Jawd (a.s.) establishes the grave of the Prophet (s.a.a.w.) as a primary destination for pilgrimage, distinct from general visitation. The promise of Paradise underscores the high spiritual status of the Prophet’s resting place in Shia tradition, linking physical devotion to eternal reward. This hadith serves as a foundational text for the practice of *Ziyarat al-Qubur* specifically directed toward the Messenger of God.
